title: Excellent experience.
text: It was superb in every way and well worth the payment. We had been to other locations but GUZZO was the best. Food was excellent and service amazing.
author: Debra_B

title: Food and Flamenco
text:
This place was a delight. Intimate. Charming. 
The staff was amazing. The food and drink also great. But the performance, truly the best part of the night.
author: Meredyth M

title: Great evening out in Barcelona!
text: Well worth the visit. The host seemed a little confused when we first got there,  but got us seated and brought us a pitcher of sangria. The food was outstanding, and there were several gluten-free options. An appetizer, entree, and dessert were included, as well as the sangria. The flamenco performance was amazing! The 4 piece ensemble were just delightful and beautiful to watch.
author: Colleen_B

title: Incredible place
text: An incredible place. Full of life, very nice and nice, amazing food, super friendly staff and simply delicious cocktails! We ate and drank at the rhythm of a wonderful concert. I went out drunk and full of pleasure and good wave! I will come back more and more and I highly recommend!!
author: MariaBeatriz_P

title: Unmatched!!
text: Loved it! Super good atmosphere, and the music good! Staff and food to suck your fingers, I will repeat for sure!
author: Anouk_M

title: Delicious!
text:
What a wonderful night!!!
We had a lot of fun...the music, the vibe, the place is super charming, the people really nice, the fooooood! 🤤🤤
Unbelievably delicious!
author: AnaCarolina_V

title: Must visit
text: It was an intimate and welcoming place, interesting flench/jazz style decor, good mediterranean food and interesting cocktails. The show was vibrant and passionate. There's emotional depth to the dance and a beautiful intense vibe. Totally recommend.
author: Lorena_M

title: Andalusia in the Guzzo
text:
We spent an authentic night in the Guzzo the atmosphere transported us directly to the heart of Andalucia. 
Very good food, varied and original dishes, and a vibrant performance with lots of goblin. I recommend this experience to anyone who wants to experience flamenco in an intimate way in Barcelona.
author: Melanie_F

title: An experience to remember and repeat
text: Excellent! We had a great time, the performance was great, entertaining and quality. Good atmosphere, super attentive staff and delicious food, tapas can never miss, delicious croquettes, authentic acorn ham and fresh squid. This time I went with my partner but I would also come with a group of friends. In short, an experience to remember and repeat.
author: Mar_F

title: Best Flamenco show in Barcelona
text: I've been to more than one flamenco show and this was really emotional. The musicians, the dancers, the place... what a night!!!! Plus, we had a lovely dinner. Totally recommend, thanks Guzzo! Will definitely come back.
author: Ines_A
